people.name: Bethlehem
people.line: City of David's birth and Jesus' birth.

people.name: Ephrathah
people.line: A wife of Caleb and founder of Bethlehem.

people.name: Ezer
people.line: Father or founder of Hushah, of Ephrathah.

people.name: Gedor
people.line: Town in Judah; home of Judahite clan members

people.name: Hur
people.line: A companion of Moses and grandfather of Bezalel.

people.name: Hushah
people.line: A son or town founded by Ezer.

people.name: Penuel
people.line: Son of Hur, descendant of Judah

translations.web: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
translations.bsb: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and the father of Bethlehem.
translations.kjv: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
translations.asv: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the first-born of Ephrathah, the father of Beth-lehem.
